Lunch in a flower shop.
Jul 2023 • Friends

Surrounded by lovely plants and serving trays decorated beautifully you are besotted from the moment you enter. 150 k for a set meal which included chicken, fish , soup and stir fried morning glory. I had gone years ago and thought of this for the special ladies I had with me today who were also totally charmed❤️
They are very responsive on Facebook messenger. Do preorder vegetarian meals a day in advance

Pretty cafe that was disappointment with rude staff
Jun 2023 • Family
Went to visit this cafe for coffee and dessert with my daughter, based on reviews. It’s a pretty little cafe tucked in an alleyway.
We arrived at 5pm and the cafe closes at 6pm, which we knew. We were immediately told it was closed because they stop serving anything after 5pm and were almost cleaned up. No other clientele were there. The hostess then said if we put in a coffee based order right away, we could order. We ordered two Vietnamese iced coffees right after, paid and went to the tiny upstairs. They brought us two coffees decorated with pretty flowers. We drank our coffees within 20 min, but decided to leave before 6pm, since no one else was there and 5 staff kept cleaning all around us, which felt unwelcoming. As we were leaving, we took some photos, and one of them made a rude comment about us in Vietnamese and the others laughed, not realizing maybe that I’m half Vietnamese and could understand them. Overall a disappointing experience.

Gorgeous, stylish, unique, beautiful
Dec 2022 • Friends
Gorgeous little boutique cafe & flower, hidden away down a alleyway, and off the beaten track. 
This beautifully renovated building has a working flower shop on the ground floor, and a cafe upstairs. 
There’s a good variety of hot & cold beverages, and some pastries on offer.
They also do serve lunch, but you need to book this online via their Facebook or Instagram pages. The menu changes daily. 
This is the most beautiful beverage presentation you will ever see : insta-worthy x100
Our Vietnamese coffees were perfectly made and delicious. Pastries were so light and flaky- best in the city. 
This is truly an unique experience and definitely worth seeking out.
Highly recommended!

One of must-try experiences in Saigon
Jul 2018 • Friends
Whenever you are in doubt of place to have lunch or dinner or a cocktail after work, just walk your way to Padma de Fleur. Whether you love flower or not, this is always a good choice to enjoy your meal while indulging in light music and excellent mother-made-like palate (cơm mẹ nấu stuff, you know), decorated with different types of flower, from red rose, cockcomb to hibicus. Free water is a Padma's signature mixture of artichoke and cilantro (aka Chinese parsley / rau mùi). Padma should be added to your top 3 list of selfie places. Where else in Saigon could you find such a vintage space coming with an array of varied and decorated ornaments & patterns on tables, glasses. silverware, chairs, candle holders and so on and so forth. If you are a person who loves "BEAUTY" - anything that's beautiful like me, you will absolutely love this place!

Unique café with authentic homemade Vietnamese lunch.
Apr 2018 • Couples
Cute and unique café that also works as a flower shop. Seems like they only serve lunch. There is no lunch menu, only a lunch set which is what the chef feels like making for the day, an indication of real homemade. Was served white rice with a soup dish (fish tomato soup), a meat dish (caramelized pork) and few vegetable dished, just like a traditional Vietnamese home cooked meal. And it certainly tasted like it too! The set was topped off with a great little refreshing desert.
Highly recommended if you want to try real traditional Vietnamese food. The café is also worth a visit, if you are looking for a casual charming central getaway from the bustling city. For lunch, just make sure to book a table, as they only have room for few walk-ins as seen from all the reserved tables on a tuesday noon.
